query: SELECT DISTINCT r.streamer_login AS "streamer_login!", r.session_id AS "session_id!" FROM twitch_stream_ai_reports r JOIN twitch_streamers_partner_state p ON LOWER(p.twitch_login) = LOWER(r.streamer_login) WHERE r.status='failed' AND r.retry_count < 3 AND p.is_partner_active = 1 ORDER BY r.session_id DESC
